Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Housing Element Update, also known as At Home in Encinitas â€“ Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2016-04 to implement the Cityâ€™s Housing Element. Contact Person: Senior Planner Strong
Staff recommends that the Council adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2016-04, titled, â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Chapter 30.36 to provide use and development standards to implement the new General Plan land use designation and new design guidelines to provide for development quality, making assorted changes required for consistency elsewhere in the Municipal and Zoning Codes, approving Local Coastal Program implementation program amendments, amending EMC Chapter 30.00 Encinitas Right to Vote Amendment to allow various changes including a change in maximum building height to accommodate three-story buildings on the sites designated in the General Plan and Zoning Map, and amending the Cardiff, Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, and Encinitas Ranch Specific Plans to amend the zone maps in those specific plans and make reference to new EMC Chapter 30.36 and provide for Housing Element implementation.â€
2016-06-22 Item 10A Housing Element Update Adoption of City Council Ordinance 2016-04

Housing Element Update, also known as At Home in Encinitas â€“ Ballot title and calling and giving notice of General Municipal Election on November 8, 2016. Contact Person: Acting Planning and Building Director Ranu
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-53 titled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, ordering the submission to the qualified electors of the City of Encinitas a certain City Proposition, which Proposition relates to the Cityâ€™s update of its Housing Program, including without limitation an update of the Cityâ€™s General Plan Housing Element, and related amendments to other portions of the Cityâ€™s General Plan, Specific Plans, Zoning Code, Zoning Map, Municipal Code, and Local Coastal Program, at the general election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016 and directing preparation of an impartial analysis for the City Proposition; and authorizing its members to file written arguments in favor of the City Proposition and providing for the filing of rebuttal arguments by its members.â€

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
